description: Star a message, or move it to `archive`, `spam` or `trash`. Archiving is how an agent says it has dealt with something, or the inbox it is working is the same length tomorrow. There is no read/unread here: read state belongs to a person and this credential is not one — use `list_folder`’s `sync_cursor` to track what you have already seen.
name: update_message
title: File a message
